lines.text: *Nom, nom*
Laplace starts wolfing down the cake, oblivious to everything around her.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... You must be hungry.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Did you not eat before you came here?

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Whoa! How did you know?

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: You're right! I haven't eaten a thing since yesterday!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: That's how long I've been hiding here!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Did you say, "since yesterday"?

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Knowing I'm hungry just from a single glance... People who make heroes really are on another level!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Just hurry up and eat.
Syuen looks Laplace over once more.
Her scrawny frame.
Her sickly complexion.
She has plenty of spirit, but she looks like she'll die before making it very far.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Tch.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Phew, I'm stuffed!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: That cake was good! Thanks for sharing some with me!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: You're really a good person!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Given how much you were drooling while watching me eat, I didn't really have much choice.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... So, what's your deal, anyway?

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: I'm Laplace!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I wasn't asking your name.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Did you have an interview?

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Yup!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: I failed!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Since I never saw you, I'm guessing you got cut in the first round.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: No surprise there, with a body like that.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Wait, do I need to be healthy to be a hero?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Yeah, obviously.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What, did you expect this to be some sort of game for kids?

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: But I heard you only need a healthy brain to become a Nikke.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: This isn't about becoming some ordinary Nikke.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The whole process is going to be painful,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: and if you're not strong enough to endure it, you could die.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That's why we're only looking to accept people who are both physically and mentally healthy.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: We're not trying to get anyone killed.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Physically and mentally healthy, huh...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: With the state you're in,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: there's no way you'd be able to handle it.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: So you're saying as long as I can endure it, I can become a hero?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Yeah, but I doubt you'll make it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: So just finish your cake and be on your way.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And don't come back here.
Syuen walks off, leaving Laplace behind.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: All I have to do is... endure...?

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: That's easy!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: All right then! From this moment, I'm gonna endure with everything I've got!
The next day...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What a pain. Another day without a single decent candidate...

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Hey there, Syuen!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Gahhh! You scared me!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You?! What's your deal?!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: It's me, Laplace!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I wasn't asking your name! Why're you here?!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: To become a hero!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: You said it yourself! All I have to do is endure, right?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: So that's what I'm gonna do! I'm gonna keep at this until you make me a hero!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Oh, I get it. You're going to stage a sit-in, are you?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You think that'll make things go your way?

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: A sit-in? No! I'm just gonna stay here and endure!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That's the same thing!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: By the way, are we not having cake today?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You think I'm crazy enough to feed you? You'll just stay longer!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You want to "endure"? Try doing it without food.
Syuen walks off.
But the next day...

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Hey there, Syuen!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You're still here?!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Yup!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And... you haven't eaten anything?
*Growl*

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: I'm fine! I'm used to going without food!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Before I first got here, I didn't even eat anything on the long walk over!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: That being said, no cake today, either?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: No!
And the day after that...

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Hey, Syuen! I'm still here!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Don't be!
And the day after the day after that...

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: See, Syuen? I'm enduring...!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Is your plan seriously to sit here and starve to death?!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: I don't plan on dying...!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And yet here you are, enduring without food and water...

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: I wouldn't say that, exactly. The bathrooms have water!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You didn't actually drink that water, did you?!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Why...? Of course I did!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Drink enough water, and you stop feeling hungry!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: You've got really clean water here! Probably for all those heroes you're making. It doesn't wreck my stomach, no matter how much I drink!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Y-you're insane...!
Laplace doesn't leave Syuen's hideout.
After a full week of this...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Hey.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Hey! It's me, Laplace!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Right, Laplace.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: You called?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Just how long do you plan on staying here?

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Until you make me a hero!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The interviews are over. Recruitment's closed, and every spot is filled!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: I see! I'll just have to wait until the next round of openings!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Listen, you think I didn't accept you for my sake?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It's for your own good. Got it?

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: It is?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Yeah, because someone as frail as you could die during the tests.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Can't you make a Nikke with just a brain, though?

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: My brain is healthy!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Who said anything about your brain?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Your body may not be able to withstand it. You could die!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: I appreciate you being honest about the danger involved,

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: but I'll be okay. I can endure it!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Ugh! There you go with that word again!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It hurts, okay?! It'll hurt so bad that even a healthy person couldn't take it!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: I'll be okay!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: If that's what I have to do to become a hero, I can take whatever you throw at me!
Laplace's eyes shine.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: This body of mine might be weak,

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: but my mind is in great shape!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: That's why I know I can do it.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: I can become a hero!
Suddenly, Syuen finds she can't look away from that gaze.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Give me just one chance.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: If you believe in me,

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: then no matter what trials or difficulties may come,

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: I'll become a hero right before your eyes. Just watch!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: *Sigh...* You win.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Fine. I'll let you join the project.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You wanted a chance, so here it is. Show us what you're made of.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It's going to be much more painful than you imagine.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: But yeah, throw yourself against the wall. Let your soul get crushed. Then we'll see if you can still go on about enduring and becoming a hero.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Thank you so much, Syuen!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Don't go blaming me later, though.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm not responsible for whatever happens, including you dying.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Haha! Of course!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Follow me. I'll get you into the lab.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: I promise to repay this kindness someday!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Don't go making any promises until you actually survive.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: So what's the deal?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: With what? Be more specific.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That Laplace kid! What's she doing here?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What do you think? She's a candidate for the project.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: With a body like that?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Is she a friend of yours?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Why would I be friends with someone like that?! I just did the interview and hired her, okay?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: So you saw how weak she is, and still chose to hire her?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I gave her a clear warning.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I told her everything. She's the one who chose to do it.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Well of course she did! That's why she walked into the interview room in the first place.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: The interviewers wouldn't stop griping about it, so I went and watched the video for her first interview.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I could immediately tell she's someone you'd find endearing, but physically she's got too many issues.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: It's obvious she wouldn't even last until the real tests even began.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That's why the interviewers cut her.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: So what? I'm the one in charge, remember?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I can add one extra participant if I want.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What if something goes wrong, and she dies halfway through?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You know what'll happen. Our image will take a hit, and that's it.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Syuen!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Ugh, you really won't let up, will you?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She says she wants it, even if it kills her. Just let it go!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You think I let her join because I wanted to? That brat held out for a whole week...!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: A whole week? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Never mind. Anyway, I passed her, so stop questioning me about it and just put her on the project.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: End of discussion.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: *Sigh...*

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Yeah, okay.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But if she can't handle it and runs off, we're going on without her. Got it?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Do whatever you want.
